summary: Vireo Growth Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Agribusiness Holdings LP, which indirectly owns Bridgewell Agribusiness LLC. The base purchase price is $40M, adjusted to ~$13.66M at closing, paid via unsecured subordinated convertible promissory notes with 3.85% interest and five-year maturity, convertible into subordinate voting shares. No board recommendation or advisor named. The transaction closed on signing, with notes issued to Sellers. The Canadian issuer's filing is mapped to a US 8-K. Watch conversion terms and share dilution; risk-arb focuses on note conversion mechanics and potential overhang.
